etymologies.etymologyHTML: From suit +‎ case.

definitions.definition: A large (usually rectangular) piece of luggage used for carrying clothes, and sometimes suits, when travelling.

quote.text: A stocky cabwoman removed a large wheeled suitcase.

quote.citation: 2022 November 30, Paul Bigland, “Destination Oban: a Sunday in Scotland”, in RAIL, number 971, page 77:
quote.text: Many seats carry reservation labels, while the luggage racks are festooned with backpacks and suitcases.

definitions.definition: (computing) In the Classic Mac OS operating system, a file containing fonts, icons, sounds, and other resources.
To trade using samples in a suitcase.
(prison slang) To smuggle in one's rectum.
